$Comment: Orrin's daily: a short sitting at the table and a tithe of Life essence, paid from one table.
Repeat.Reset with Period Daily is a CALENDAR daily, not a rolling wait: the allowance refreshes
at the day boundary on server time, so a player who finishes late in the evening can go again
the next morning rather than waiting a fixed number of hours from whenever they last claimed.
Author AtMinutes on the Reset block to move the boundary off midnight, or replace Period with
an Every block to set any other length.
It opens once First Unmaking is claimed, so every player who takes it owns a table and knows
how to run it. Both steps sit on Order 1, so they run together: rites counts pieces the tables
took apart (STATION_INPUT, blank Target so any piece counts, qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table'
on PREFIX so both tiers count and the Sawmill does not, with the shared unmake_gear TextKey),
and tithe hands Life essence in to Orrin only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'). The table pays essence for
every piece, so one sitting covers both. Raise or lower either Amount to change how long a
The whole payout is ONE Lootable reward, Lootables/Mmo_Enchanter_Rites.json, which grows with
the player's Enchanting level and luck and carries the daily's chance rolls; retune the odds
there, and nothing in this file needs to change to make the daily more or less generous. The
reward sits in the Claim bucket, so the roll happens when the player collects it.
Listing puts it in the misc category with the Repeatable tag, the same shelf as the sawyer's
